title: Early Black Friday Deals Kickoff With Steep Discounts on Apple Watch Ultras and More
content:
Black Friday deals officially kicked off this week, with early savings on everything from Apple Watch Ultra models to Mac mini, Mac Studio, HomeView pre-orders, and more.

Note: MacRumors is an affiliate partner with some of these vendors. When you click a link and make a purchase, we may receive a small payment, which helps us keep the site running.

Apple Watch Ultra 4



  • What's the deal? Get $99 off Apple Watch Ultra 4

  • Where can I get it? Amazon

  • Where can I find the original deal? Right here

$99 OFF
Apple Watch Ultra 4 for $699.99


The Apple Watch Ultra 4 has dropped to $699.99 on Amazon, down from $799.00. This is a match of the all-time low price on the new Ultra 4, which just launched in September.

Apple Watch Ultra 3



  • What's the deal? Get $250 off Apple Watch Ultra 3

  • Where can I get it? Best Buy

  • Where can I find the original deal? Right here

$250 OFF
Apple Watch Ultra 3 for $549.00

$250 OFF
Apple Watch Ultra 3 (Milanese Loop) for $649.00


Best Buy this week has a big collection of Apple Watch Ultra 3 models for $549.00, down from $799.00. This is a massive $250 discount on the previous-generation device, and it represents a new all-time low price on these models. You can find similar $250 discounts on the Milanese Loop models at Amazon.

HomeView



  • What's the deal? Get $9 off HomeView pre-orders

  • Where can I get it? Amazon

  • Where can I find the original deal? Right here

$9 OFF
HomeView for $289.99


Amazon's $9 pre-order discount on the HomeView has returned for the Space Gray color, allowing you to get the home hub for $289.99, down from $299.00.

B&H Photo



  • What's the deal? Shop sitewide savings on storage, audio, and more accessories

  • Where can I find the original deal? Right here

SITEWIDE SALE
B&H Photo Early Black Friday


B&H Photo introduced its early Black Friday sale this week, with savings on storage accessories, home and portable audio devices, drones, cameras, Apple products, and more.

Mac Mini and Mac Studio



  • What's the deal? Get record low prices on Mac mini and Mac Studio

  • Where can I get it? Amazon

  • Where can I find the original deal? Right here

$200 OFF
M5 Max Mac Studio 36GB/512GB for $2,299.00

$120 OFF
M6 Mac mini 16GB/256GB for $779.00

$150 OFF
M6 Mac mini 16GB/512GB for $949.00


Apple's M5 Max Mac Studio with 36GB RAM and a 512GB SSD is still on sale for $2,299.00, down from $2,499.00. Regarding the Mac mini, you can get the 16GB RAM/256GB SSD Mac mini for $779.00, down from $899.00, and the 16GB RAM/512GB SSD model for $949.00, down from $1,099.00.

If you're on the hunt for more discounts, be sure to visit our Apple Deals roundup where we recap the best Apple-related bargains of the past week.
